chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, from Umar ibn Yazeed, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed twenty Hajjs.
ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet Muhammad perform Hajj according to Shia hadith sources?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi, narrated through the chain of Yunus ibn Ya'qub, asserts that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) performed Hajj twenty times, a figure often interpreted by Shia scholars to include both the obligatory Hajj al-Ifad and the numerous voluntary (Tatawwu') pilgrimages he undertook throughout his life. This emphasizes the Prophet's role as the perfect exemplar of worship, reinforcing the spiritual merit of frequent pilgrimage beyond the single obligatory rite. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the depth of the Prophet's devotional practice in Shia tradition.
